name: session-vitals
description: Your Claude Code session at a glance, under the prompt: context bar, rate limits, prompt cache stats with a live TTL countdown, model and git branch

ttlMinutes.title: Automatic prompt cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: Countdown length when no TTL is set (no /cache-ttl, promptCacheTtl setting or CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL): 60 on a subscription, 5 on an API key

expiryTo5m.title: First turn after the cache expires uses the 5-minute cache
expiryTo5m.description: When the countdown reaches zero, the next turn writes the cache with the 5m TTL (cheaper after a long pause); the TTL you had comes back once that turn ends
